description: Updates the authenticated user's preference for showing or hiding members in a specific Trello board's sidebar, affecting only the current user's view.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for updating the user's preference for showing members in the board sidebar.

idBoard.description: The unique identifier of the Trello board for which the sidebar member visibility preference will be updated.
idBoard.title: Id Board

value.description: Determines whether to show members in the board sidebar. Set to 'true' to show members, or 'false' to hide them. This is a per-user preference.
value.title: Value

inputSchema.title: UpdateBoardSidebarMembersPrefRequest

name: update_board_sidebar_members_pref

UpdateBoardSidebarMembersPrefResponse.description:
Response schema for updating the user's preference for showing members in the board sidebar.

Returns the full user preferences object for the board after the update.

emailPosition.description: Position of email in the board (e.g., 'bottom', 'top').
emailPosition.title: Email Position

idEmailList.description: ID of the email list for this board.
idEmailList.title: Id Email List

showCompactMirrorCards.description: Whether compact mirror cards are shown.
showCompactMirrorCards.title: Show Compact Mirror Cards

showSidebarActivity.description: Whether activity is shown in the sidebar.
showSidebarActivity.title: Show Sidebar Activity

showSidebarBoardActions.description: Whether board actions are shown in the sidebar.
showSidebarBoardActions.title: Show Sidebar Board Actions

showSidebarMembers.description: Whether members are shown in the board sidebar.
showSidebarMembers.title: Show Sidebar Members

UpdateBoardSidebarMembersPrefResponse.title: UpdateBoardSidebarMembersPrefResponse
